name: rajibul-portfolio
description: Tests for the portfolio site. The site itself has no build step.

scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:browser
scripts.validate: html-validate index.html && node --check js/main.js && node --check js/starfield.js && node --check js/tilt.js && node --check js/theme-init.js
scripts.vendor: node -e "const f=require('fs');f.writeFileSync('js/vendor/motion.js','/*! Motion '+require('motion/package.json').version+' | MIT License | https://motion.dev | copied from node_modules/motion/dist by \x60npm run vendor\x60 */\n'+f.readFileSync('node_modules/motion/dist/motion.js','utf8'))"
